useChop = input.bool(true, "Chop filter: ADX<20 or range<0.35 dATR")
useDead = input.bool(true, "Midday dead zone 12:00-13:30 ET")

// ---------- time (America/New_York, bar OPEN time) ----------
tz = "America/New_York"
hhmm = hour(time, tz) * 100 + minute(time, tz)
dInt = year(time, tz) * 10000 + month(time, tz) * 100 + dayofmonth(time, tz)
inRTH = hhmm >= 930 and hhmm < 1600
rthStart = inRTH and not inRTH[1]

// ---------- session state, built in-script (no request.security on HTF) ----------

var float dL = na
var float pdH = na
var float pdL = na
var float pdC = na
var float lastRthC = na
var float orH = na
var float orL = na
var float onH = na
var float onL = na
var float sPV = 0.0
var float sV = 0.0
var float dATR = na
var float rthOpen = na
var int nL = 0
var int nS = 0
if hhmm == 1800
    onH := high
    onL := low
else if not inRTH and not na(onH)
    onH := math.max(onH, high)
    onL := math.min(onL, low)
if rthStart
    if not na(dH)
        tr = math.max(dH, nz(pdC, dH)) - math.min(dL, nz(pdC, dL))
        dATR := na(dATR) ? tr : (dATR * 13 + tr) / 14
        pdH := dH
        pdL := dL
        pdC := lastRthC
    dH := high
    dL := low
    orH := high
    orL := low
    sPV := 0.0
    sV := 0.0
    rthOpen := open
    nL := 0
    nS := 0
else if inRTH
    dH := math.max(dH, high)
    dL := math.min(dL, low)
    if hhmm < 945
        orH := math.max(orH, high)
        orL := math.min(orL, low)
if inRTH
    sPV += hlc3 * volume
    sV += volume
    lastRthC := close

orReady = inRTH and hhmm >= 945

// ---------- shared indicators ----------
// m101 (Gen 2): ATR from RTH bars only + stop floor of 0.25 x daily ATR

stopFloor = nz(0.25 * dATR, 0.0)

rangeOk = hhmm < 1030 or na(dATR) ? true : (dH - dL) / dATR >= 0.35

    vixPrev := vixLast

    vixLast := vixC

    if dist > 0
        q := math.floor(strategy.equity * riskPct / 100.0 / (dist * syminfo.pointvalue))

var float stopPx = na
var float tgtPx = na
var float rPts = na
var float entRef = na
var bool trailOn = false

// ================= AGENT ALPHA: Opening-range / VWAP / DMI momentum =================

    dnUsed := false

    d = math.max(atr, stopFloor)
    q = f_qty(d)
    if q >= 1

        rPts := d
        entRef := close
        trailOn := false

        strategy.exit("XL", "L", stop=stopPx)

    d = math.max(atr, stopFloor)
    q = f_qty(d)
    if q >= 1

        rPts := d
        entRef := close
        strategy.entry("S", strategy.short, qty=q)
        strategy.exit("XS", "S", stop=stopPx, limit=tgtPx)

    strategy.exit("XL", "L", stop=stopPx)
    if high >= entRef + rPts

    if trailOn and close < ema9

    strategy.exit("XS", "S", stop=stopPx, limit=tgtPx)
    if barsIn >= 6 and close > entRef - 0.5 * rPts
        strategy.close("S", comment="time stop")

if hhmm >= 1550 or not inRTH
    strategy.close_all(comment="EOD")

    float fees = 2.0 * pN * feeLeg + (isSettle ? 0.0 : 2.0 * pN * feeLeg)
    float pnl = (pC - exitV - slipX) * 100.0 * pN - fees
    f_add(pPer, 0, 1.0)
    f_add(pPer, 26, pnl)
    if pnl > 0
        f_add(pPer, 1, 1.0)
    f_add(pPer, pnl > 0 ? 2 : 3, math.abs(pnl))
    int sb = posPut ? 4 : 8
    f_add(pPer, sb, 1.0)
    if pnl > 0
        f_add(pPer, sb + 1, 1.0)
        f_add(pPer, sb + 2, pnl)
    else
        f_add(pPer, sb + 3, -pnl)
    f_add(pPer, 12, pnl)
    float eqN = f_g(pPer, 12)

    if ddN > f_g(pPer, 14)

    f_add(pPer, 18, (time_close - pEntryT) / 60000.0)

bool fomcNo = isFomc and hhmm >= 1300

    bool isPut = goLong
    float limitK = na

        inval := isPut ? bConfLo : bConfHi

        inval := isPut ? pbLow - 0.25 * atr : pbHigh + 0.25 * atr
    float dMax = isPut ? 0.15 : 0.20
    f_add(per, 19, 1.0)
    [Ks, dls] = f_findShort(close, limitK, isPut, Tyr, sig, dMax)
    bool pinBad = hhmm >= 1430 and not na(Ks) and math.abs(Ks - close) / close <= 0.005

    else

        float bestN = na
        bool floorFail = false
        bool budgetFail = false
        float eqP = f_g(per, 12)
        for w in array.from(15.0, 10.0, 5.0)

                float cr = f_spread(close, Ks, Kl, isPut, Tyr, sig) - slipSpread

// Quant Tournament Gen 3 / H1 + H2 (pre-registered). Direction-free short premium: sell one SPXW 0DTE iron condor at the
// 10:00 ET bar close, short strikes = first 5-pt strike with |delta| <= dMax on each side, fixed wings. Exit at 50% of
// credit (5m close value) or at the 15:30 close. No stop: max loss is defined by the wings.
// MODELED pricing: Black-Scholes, ATM IV = VIX1D x atmScale, linear put skew in moneyness (three values = three books).
// Skew calibrated 2026-11-20 from real SPXW 0DTE trades at 10:00 ET: put slope 0.10-0.31 per 1% OTM (regime-dependent), call side flat.
// Books 0-2: H1 (no filter). Books 3-5: H2 (skip if VIX > VIX3M, event day, or |open gap| > 1 daily ATR).
// In-sample only: nothing at or after oosStart is simulated, so the OOS window stays unseen.

skMid = input.float(0.20, "Put skew, mid book")
skHi = input.float(0.30, "Put skew, high book")
callSkew = input.float(0.0, "Call IV reduction per 1% OTM")
atmScale = input.float(1.0, "ATM IV = VIX1D x this (set from the anchor check)")
slipVert = input.float(0.10, "Slippage per vertical per fill ($ premium)")
feeLeg = input.float(1.0, "Fee per contract per leg per side ($)")
wing = input.float(10, "Wing width (points)")
dMax = input.float(0.15, "Short strike max |delta|")
capital = input.float(100000, "Starting equity per book")
oosStart = timestamp("America/New_York", 2026, 8, 1, 0, 0)

tz = "America/New_York"
hh = hour(time, tz)
mi = minute(time, tz)
hhmm = hh * 100 + mi
dInt = year(time, tz) * 10000 + month(time, tz) * 100 + dayofmonth(time, tz)
inRTH = hhmm >= 930 and hhmm < 1600
rthStart = inRTH and (dInt != nz(dInt[1]) or not inRTH[1])
tmin = 960 - (hh * 60 + mi + 5)
Tyr = math.max(tmin, 0) / 390.0 / 252.0

var float dH = na
var float dL = na
var float pdC = na
var float lastRthC = na
var float dATR = na
var float rthOpen = na

    if not na(dH)
        tr = math.max(dH, nz(pdC, dH)) - math.min(dL, nz(pdC, dL))
        dATR := na(dATR) ? tr : (dATR * 13 + tr) / 14
        pdC := lastRthC

    dL := low
    rthOpen := open

f_ncdf(float x) =>
    float z = math.abs(x) / math.sqrt(2.0)
    float t = 1.0 / (1.0 + 0.3275911 * z)
    float y = 1.0 - (((((1.061405429 * t - 1.453152027) * t) + 1.421413741) * t - 0.284496736) * t + 0.254829592) * t * math.exp(-z * z)
    x >= 0 ? 0.5 * (1.0 + y) : 0.5 * (1.0 - y)
f_iv(float S, float K, float base, bool isPut, float ps) =>
    float m = isPut ? (S - K) / S * 100.0 : (K - S) / S * 100.0
    float mult = isPut ? 1.0 + ps * m : 1.0 - callSkew * m
    base * math.max(mult, 0.6)
f_bs(float S, float K, float T, float iv, bool isPut) =>
    float px = 0.0
    float dl = 0.0
    if T <= 0.0000001 or iv <= 0
        px := isPut ? math.max(K - S, 0) : math.max(S - K, 0)
        dl := isPut ? (S < K ? -1.0 : 0.0) : (S > K ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    else
        float sd = iv * math.sqrt(T)
        float d1 = (math.log(S / K) + 0.5 * iv * iv * T) / sd
        float d2 = d1 - sd
        if isPut
            px := K * f_ncdf(-d2) - S * f_ncdf(-d1)
            dl := f_ncdf(d1) - 1.0
        else
            px := S * f_ncdf(d1) - K * f_ncdf(d2)
            dl := f_ncdf(d1)
    [px, dl]
f_vert(float S, float Ks, float Kl, bool isPut, float T, float base, float ps) =>
    [a, da] = f_bs(S, Ks, T, f_iv(S, Ks, base, isPut, ps), isPut)
    [b, db] = f_bs(S, Kl, T, f_iv(S, Kl, base, isPut, ps), isPut)
    a - b
f_short(float S, bool isPut, float T, float base, float ps) =>
    float K0 = isPut ? math.floor(S / 5.0) * 5.0 : math.ceil(S / 5.0) * 5.0
    float found = na
    for i = 0 to 200

        if math.abs(dl) <= dMax
            found := Ki
            break
    found
f_intr(float S, float kps, float kpl, float kcs, float kcl) =>
    math.max(kps - S, 0) - math.max(kpl - S, 0) + math.max(S - kcs, 0) - math.max(S - kcl, 0)

// Quant Tournament Gen 3 / H3 (pre-registered). Signal: sign of the first-half-hour return (prior RTH close -> 10:00 ET).
// Trade: enter in that direction at the 15:30 ET open, exit at the 16:00 ET open. No stop. 1x notional sizing.
// Null: a random-direction trade has mean 0, so t = mean(signed return - cost) / (sd / sqrt(n)).

// so it does not touch closed-trade performance).

    else

    strategy.close_all(comment="16:00 exit")

var float n = 0.0
var float sx = 0.0
var float sxx = 0.0
var float sy = 0.0
var float syy = 0.0
var float hits = 0.0
if hhmm == 1555 and not na(o1530) and not na(r1) and r1 != 0 and time < statsTime
    float rl = close - o1530
    float x = math.sign(r1) * rl - costPts
    float y = rl - costPts
    n += 1
    sx += x
    sxx += x * x
    sy += y
    syy += y * y
    hits += math.sign(r1) * rl > 0 ? 1 : 0

var bool stamped = false
if not stamped and time >= statsTime and n > 2
    stamped := true
    float mx = sx / n
    float sdx = math.sqrt(math.max(sxx / n - mx * mx, 0) * n / (n - 1))
    float tx = sdx > 0 ? mx / (sdx / math.sqrt(n)) : na
    float my = sy / n
    float sdy = math.sqrt(math.max(syy / n - my * my, 0) * n / (n - 1))
    float ty = sdy > 0 ? my / (sdy / math.sqrt(n)) : na
    string txt = "STATS n=" + str.tostring(n, "#") + " mean_pts=" + str.tostring(mx, "#.###") + " sd=" + str.tostring(sdx, "#.##") + " t=" + str.tostring(tx, "#.##") + " hit=" + str.tostring(hits / n, "#.###") + " | always-long mean_pts=" + str.tostring(my, "#.###") + " t=" + str.tostring(ty, "#.##")
    strategy.entry("STATS", strategy.long, qty=1, comment=txt)
